en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realised through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧ : ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਉ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 1 : jehaa beeau tehaa fal paiee

en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realised through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦੂੰ ਨੀਵੀਂ ਧਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਦਰਗਹ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: sabh dhoo(n) neevee(n) dharat hoi dharageh a(n)dhar milee vaddaiee|

en.bdb: The earth is most humble and hence respected in the court of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਗੋਡੈ ਵਾਹਿ ਹਲੁ ਕੋ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਕੁਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: koiee goddai vaeh hal ko mal mootr kusootr karaiee|

en.bdb: One hoes it, other ploughs it and someone impures it by defecating it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਿੰਬਿ ਰਸੋਈ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਪੂਜਿ ਚੜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: li(n)b rasoiee ko karai choaa cha(n)dhan pooj chaRaiee|

en.bdb: Plastering it one prepares kitchen over it and someone worships it by offering sandal sticks.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਉ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: jehaa beejai so lunai jehaa beeau tehaa fal paiee|

en.bdb: One reaps what one sows and receives the fruit of seeds offered to earth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal sahaj ghar aap gavai na aap ganaiee|

en.bdb: Getting stabilised in the innate nature gurmukhs receive the pleasure-fruits. Eschewing ego they never allow themselves to be counted anywhere.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਗ੍ਰਤ ਸੁਪਨ ਸੁਖੋਪਤੀ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਮਗਨ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: jaagrat supan sukhopatee unaman magan rahai liv laiee|

en.bdb: They, in all the four stages - jagrat (conscious) svapan (dream), susupati (deep sleep or trance) and turiya (indetical with the supreme lord) - remain merged in the love of the Lord.
One accomplishes the word of the Guru in the company of saints.
